غَرْغَرَةٌ A sound with which is a roughness, (K,) like that which is made by one gargling with water. (TA.) ―
-b2- The sound of a cooking-pot when it boils. (K.) ―
-b3- The reciprocation of the spirit in the throat. (S.) ―
-b4- A word imitative of the cry of the pastor (K, TA.) and the like. (TA.) [See also R. Q. 1.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
